text:
ana: Quick prod update — just rolled out the 'granule-batcher' + 'predictive-kv' combo to the text-gen canary (10% traffic). Early numbers look promising: overall token cost ~-12%, p95 latency ~-18%. p50 improved ~10%.

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/serve@granule-batcher+predictive-kv -> canary (cluster: prod-gen-canary)

sre-bot: canary healthchecks: 5m OK, CPU stable, 1 pod restarted (OOM) — investigating

mike: awesome! which routes/models are in the canary?

ana: applied to the light/med seq generation routes only: redwood-7b, rw-13b-quant, and the small-chat stack. Not touching long-seq heavy traffic yet.

olivia: nice win. curious about tail behavior — any change to p99 or error rates?

ana: p99 is flat overall; we saw a tiny p99 increase (+4ms) for sequences >1024 tokens. To mitigate we added a quick fallback: requests with seq>2048 use the legacy packer path. That is in the canary config.

mike: do we have a rough $$ estimate for hosted spend?

ana: extrapolating current traffic mix -> ~9% net monthly savings if we roll to 100%. If we enable batching density tweaks (next PR) we can squeeze ~2-3% more.

olivia: can you paste the config changes so I can repro locally?

ana: sure — local repro: run ./dev/run_infer.sh --model redwood-7b --seq 512 --qps 5 and use this override:

```
batcher.granule.max_size=48
batcher.granule.target_fill=0.82
kv.predictive.prefetch_ratio=0.6
fallback.seq_threshold=2048
```

ana: PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/1829|#1829> — contains benchmarks + flamegraphs.

sre-bot: incident note — that one pod OOM on startup was due to aggressive slot allocation combined with a 48->64 bump on a particular machine. Pod auto-restarted, no client-facing errors.

ana: fixed: reduced batcher.granule.max_size to 48 in the canary and added a soft memory cap check; new rollout includes the cap.

sam: can you add a short blurb to the release notes (console -> release feed) and tag eng-sre + devex? Also add a quick how-to in /docs/runtime/ops for fallback toggles.

ana: will do. Planned full roll to 100% in ~24h assuming no regressions; will post a final result summary then.

mike: any flags we should expose to customers for Dedicated/private deployments?

ana: we kept it opt-in for Dedicated for now (config flag: enable_granule_predictive=true) — want to collect a few more scale datapoints before making it default.

olivia: :tada: great work team — nice cost win.

mike: quick follow-ups: (1) can you add the p95 by model in the PR? (2) perf tests for mixed short/long sessions?

ana: yes to both — adding graphs to PR now and queuing a mixed-session perf run.

deploy-bot: canary -> 10% complete, last health window OK

ana: thanks all — I'll post the 24h wrap with final numbers.

olivia: +1 — thanks for the clear notes :thumbsup:
